| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Amplitude** `amplitude` | 40 | 0 to 128 levels | The height A of the wave, in 8-bit levels. |
| **Frequency x** `fx` | 0.125 | -0.5 to 0.5 cycles/px | How many waves fit in one pixel along x. 0.125 means a wave every 8 pixels. |
| **Frequency y** `fy` | 0 | -0.5 to 0.5 cycles/px | How many waves fit in one pixel along y. |
| **Phase** `phase` | 0 | 0 to 360 deg | Where the wave starts at the top left pixel. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
